fields: kwh is the label's energy over per cycles: ENERGY STAR's yearly figure over the cycles the DOE's test procedure takes a year (295 washes, 283 dryings, 215 dishwasher runs), EPREL's per 100 cycles of a washer's or dishwasher's eco programme, and a dryer's weighted yearly figure over its 160 cycles (gas in kWh where a dryer is gas). capacity is cubic feet (ENERGY STAR's washers and dryers), kilograms (EPREL's washers and dryers) or place settings (dishwashers). Each list keeps one row a kind, brand and model, the latest placed on the market. Wildcards in an ENERGY STAR model number (* or #) stand for the letters of a color or a variant.

es.source: ENERGY STAR's certified residential clothes washers, clothes dryers and dishwashers (data.energystar.gov bghd-e2wd, t9u7-4d2j, q8py-6w3f), America's and Canada's; a row's page is https://www.energystar.gov/productfinder/product/certified-<kind>/details/<id>

eprel.source: EPREL, the EU's registry for energy labelling (washingmachines2019, dishwashers2019, tumbledriers), searched by the brands Britain's and Ireland's shops sell; washers and dishwashers placed on the market from 2021, dryers from 2019; a row's label is https://eprel.ec.europa.eu/qr/<id>
